## Executive Summary

This section describes the significant realizations of the [Application] in the form of Use Cases.

This appendix lists all architecturally significant priority realizations of the Medi-Cal [Application] in the form of use cases and object interaction diagrams representing the components. These are significant use cases that demonstrate the end-to-end services provided by Gainwell Technologies (hereinafter Gainwell). For all acronym definitions, see *SDP\_Enterprise\_Appendix\_A\_Acronyms.docx*.

1. Template Content <replace with service specific realizations>

| Content | Description | Outreach Channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Welcome Package | Welcome letter; Flyers, including Claim submission & follow up, electronic billing, education resources, navigating Medi-Cal and specialty health programs. | Direct Mail, Email |
| Billing & Support | Questions regarding billing, pay through mail, email, Short Message Service (SMS), send contact information for provider support. Example: Questions regarding Covid-19, Electronic billing. | Direct Mail, Email, SMS (Depends upon length of the message) |
| Educational Sessions | Inform providers regarding scheduled seminars & webinars, workshops (Basic Billing, Advance Billing) and specialized trainings (For Example: Durable Medical Equipment (DME), or Family Planning, Access, Care, Treatment (FPACT). | Direct Mail, Email, SMS  (Medi-Cal Website) |
| Reference Material | Marketing material such as electronic billing, billing tips, provider manual, Erroneous Payment Correction (EPC) Letters. | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
| Quick Tips | Billing tips, Claims Submission Instructions (Electronic & hardcopy). | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
| Best Practices | Proven Medi-Cal billing tips based on research results & Medi-Cal policy. | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
| Common Small Provider Q&A | Questions and Answers regarding new or updated policy. | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
| Specialty or Type | Physicians, pharmacy, CCS, GHPP, Facility (Inpatient, Outpatient, Long Term Care). | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
| Whom to Contact for Help | Marketing call center services, Regional Representative, and whom to contact for assistance. | Direct Mail, Email, SMS |
